caption: The drawing is done in pencil and features several detailed illustrations of clothing and textile designs on a plain, light background. The central object is a full-length dress with short puffed sleeves, a high waist, and decorative embroidery patterns running vertically along the skirt, bodice, sleeves, and hem. To the right of the dress, there are three vertical rectangular swatches of embroidery or lace patterns, each labeled with measurements and filled with repeated symmetrical motifs. Below these swatches, there is a horizontal piece of cloth with a scalloped edge and decorative border, and next to it is a triangular or bonnet-shaped cap with embroidered detailing and labeled "2". Further down, a short-sleeved blouse with ruffled collar and sleeves is depicted, tied at the waist with a string. Adjacent to it are two detailed drawings resembling embroidered or lace patches, one in a starburst or cross shape and the other resembling a small cluster of leaves or floral spray. The overall color of the drawing is grayscale, relying on shading and line work to depict texture and depth. Measurement annotations are included next to several objects, and a signature in the lower right corner reads "Ella Josephine Seder" with the date "1938."
title: Embroidered Christening Robe & Mull Cap
